"use client";
import {useEffect,useState} from "react";
import {signInBackend,signOutBackend} from "@kago/backend";
import {createBrowserBackendClient} from "@/lib/backend/browser";
import {SponsoredArtwork} from "@/features/recommendations/sponsored-artwork";
export default function MediaTestPage(){
 const [ready,setReady]=useState(false),[version,setVersion]=useState("");
 useEffect(()=>{
  let active=true;const client=createBrowserBackendClient();
  signInBackend(client,"customer@example.test","fixture-password","customer").then(()=>{
   if(active){setVersion(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("version")??"");setReady(true);}
  });
  return()=>{active=false;};
 },[]);
 return <main>
  <div style={{position:"relative",width:360,height:360}}>{ready&&<SponsoredArtwork versionId={version} sizes="360px" fallback={<span>代わりの商品画像</span>}/>}</div>
  <button onClick={async()=>{await signOutBackend(createBrowserBackendClient());setReady(false);}}>ログアウト</button>
 </main>;
}
